Default Prove-Up.
Off Calendar Oct-23-2007 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for Default Prove-Up Hearing this day.
Dept. 218, Comm. Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: K. Farnsworth.
Douglas Holloway, Esq. for Plaintiff: Bank of the West.
Order waiving live testimony is in file.
After hearing the evidence presented and considering of the filed declartion, the Court rules in favor of the Plaintiff and against the Defaulted Defendants: Joseph Velasquez, Merlinda Velasques, Thomas Abster Corp, Tommy Riddle, Jr., and Dorluci, Inc. as follows:
Total Damages $169,521.80
Total Prejudgment Interest $7,042.64
Total Attorney's Fees $7,500.00
Total Costs $1,420.00, for a grand total of $185,484.44
Plaintiff is also entitled to the immediate possession of the leased equipment listed in the Judgment.
Judgment signed in open court.
